svg.text: Unit symbols for PHYSICAL units - what each layer switch shows (DESIGN_Unit_Symbols)
Grey annotations are not drawn by the app. Scope: the units' NATO symbol, the unit card, the new layer row. The men's silhouettes and cards are context (today's look).
men + their cards (today) · each SQUAD's card gains the symbol cell; the platoon's
card too. ⚠ busy close up - that is today's men's cards, not the symbols
B NATO off: today's look + the strength bar
exactly today, plus the unit card's strength bar (UI-11) - no symbol
C Labels off: men + symbols at the squads
the men's silhouettes + ONE symbol per squad at its centroid (the
D symbols only: the commander's map
Entities off, Labels off: only the units' symbols - the classic
overlay; one echelon at a time by zoom (below)
Entities off: the units' cards with their symbols, the men hidden -
an ORBAT laid on the map
NATO off, Labels off: today's men only - nothing new is drawn
G one ECHELON at a time, by zoom (standalone symbols - cases C and D)
the level whose symbols stand ~40 px apart; a SELECTED unit also shows its children one level down
3-D: the symbol lives in the CARD only (upright, screen-sized)
NEW: every UNIT's symbol - in its card, or alone at its point
The rule, by construction ONE symbol per unit:
NATO on + Labels on ⇒ the card's cell (cases A, E)
NATO on + Labels off ⇒ alone at the unit's point (C, D), one echelon by zoom (G)
NATO off ⇒ none (B, F) - today's look
A unit = a squad / platoon / company entity (UnitRoster); its point = its live men's centroid (UnitCentroidSystem).
Men and vehicles: their rotated silhouettes always, as today - never a NATO sign (DESIGN_Stochastic_Unit_UI §6 S-8).
